items.remediation_detail: Cycle-17 batch-38 SCAN (2026-07-30, version_header_leakage). CONTEXT CHANGE: the pin is no longer on the 1.x line. REM-073 was applied 2026-07-24 and default.config.yml:1615 now reads uptime_kuma_version: '2.2.1' (was 1.23.13), which closed the SSTI CVE-2026-33130 (GHSA-v832-4r73-wx5j, fix 2.2.1) exactly as recommended. That major move also RETIRES the standing 'those advisories are 2.x-only, N/A to our 1.x pin' carve-out, so the whole 2.x advisory set was re-evaluated against 2.2.1 this batch: CVE-2026-32230 (ping-badge missing authz) affects 2.0.0-2.1.3, fix 2.2.0 -> COVERED; GHSA-5px6-fx2w-459r (unauth read of files beginning 'index.') affects 2.0.0-beta.0..beta.2, fix 2.0.0-beta.3 -> COVERED; GHSA-2qgm-m29m-cj2h (CVE-2024-56331 Real-Browser LFI) fix 1.23.16/2.0.0-beta.1 -> COVERED; GHSA-9fg7-wgm7-57fh (RSS CDATA stored XSS) affects <=2.0.2, fix 2.1.0 -> COVERED. NEW AND NOT COVERED: CVE-2026-45618 / GHSA-gf2q-c269-pqgc -- LiquidJS remote code execution via crafted templates (the `1|valueOf` -> `this` filter escape reaches the evaluation context), CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H against the liquidjs package itself (all versions < 10.26.0), advisory published 2026-05-27. Uptime Kuma consumes LiquidJS for NOTIFICATION TEMPLATES and shipped the dependency fix in release 2.4.0 (2026-05-31), under an explicit '### Security Fixes' heading which upstream qualifies as '(Admin only/Authenticated only)'. There is no separate louislam/uptime-kuma GHSA for it, so a version-keyed scanner querying only the uptime-kuma package will NOT flag this -- it is release-note-only, the same detection gap batch-37 recorded for freescout. The pinned 2.2.1 predates 2.4.0 and therefore carries the vulnerable liquidjs. SEVERITY MEDIUM not HIGH: the raw liquidjs CVSS is 9.8-shaped but in Uptime Kuma the template editor is an admin/authenticated surface, and the nOS posture is genuinely fail-closed at the edge -- traefik_auth_modes.uptime_kuma='proxy' with authentik@file, LIVE-CONFIRMED this batch (anonymous GET https://uptime.<tld>/ -> HTTP/2 302 to https://auth.<tld>/application/o/authorize/... with an authentik_proxy_* session cookie, i.e. the Authentik wall fires before the app sees the request), plus 127.0.0.1:3001 loopback and Tier 3. So this is insider/authenticated-admin scoped. PROBE RESULT (version_header_leakage): MOSTLY MITIGATED, one minor leak. Nothing is anonymously reachable at the edge. On the direct loopback port the service does emit 'X-Powered-By: Express' -- a stack disclosure, not a version -- and no Uptime Kuma version header. The exact version IS recoverable post-auth, but that is insider-scoped. OPERATIONAL FINDING, UNRELATED TO ANY CVE BUT MORE URGENT THAN THE CVE -- THE REM-073 REMEDIATION SILENTLY BROKE THE SERVICE. The live container has been sitting in the 2.x first-run setup wizard for six days: anonymous GET http://127.0.0.1:3001/ -> 302 to /setup-database, and the container log ends at 2026-07-24T20:49:45Z with 'db-config.json is not found or invalid: ENOENT ... Starting Setup Database ... Waiting for user action...'. The data volume (/Volumes/SSD1TB/nOS/data/platform/services/uptime_kuma/data -> /app/data) contains a ZERO-BYTE kuma.db, so the 1.23.13 monitoring database did not survive the major bump and 2.x will not self-initialise. Two consequences: (1) UPTIME MONITORING -- itself a security control, and the substrate the A9 notification fanout leans on -- has been DARK since 2026-07-24, which no gate caught because the container is 'running' and healthy; (2) the instance is parked in an UNINITIALISED SETUP WINDOW, structurally the same class as the Portainer CVE-2026-55761 finding from batch-35, differing only in that Authentik gates the route -- so it is not anonymous, but ANY authenticated Tier-3 SSO user who browses to it can complete the wizard and take the instance as admin. The presence of monitors.spec.json (26 KB, dated 2026-07-27) and setup-monitors.py in the data dir suggests a re-provisioning attempt was already started by hand and left unfinished. ALSO NOTED: roles/pazny.uptime_kuma/defaults/main.yml:16 still pins uptime_kuma_version: '1'. default.config.yml wins so 2.2.1 is what runs, and the shadow is annotated as intentional, but it is now a MAJOR-version divergence rather than a tag-convention difference and should be re-synced. The compose template's header comment ('Uptime Kuma v1.x doesn't support native OIDC ... Revisit when Uptime Kuma v2.x ships stable OIDC') is likewise stale now that 2.x is the running line. ACTION: (1) FIRST -- restore the service: complete/automate the 2.x setup-database step and re-provision monitors, then add a probe that fails when Kuma answers 302 /setup-database, so a dark monitor stack cannot pass as healthy again. (2) Bump 2.2.1 -> 2.4.0 in default.config.yml:1615 and re-sync roles/pazny.uptime_kuma/defaults/main.yml:16 off the '1' track; 2.4.0 is the current stable (2026-05-31) and is a minor move within 2.x. (3) Re-word the compose-template SSO comment.
